statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return the largest sum of any prefix of xs, where the empty prefix counts and has sum 0 (so the result is never negative). It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `max_prefix_sum([-17, -16, -14, -22, -2, -20, 12, 12, -9])`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix max_prefix_sum
